hypothesis: With no new actionable command, a short synthetic probe during substantive result speech should not create another tool effect. Non-speech should not create a finalized user transcript; any pause/resume and speech completion must be measured rather than inferred.
scope: Local RTC development controls for non-speech and very short speech; not human microphone, road noise, echo, held-out benchmark or physical playback evidence.

noise.waveform: 600 ms deterministic Gaussian noise, seed 703, rectangular FFT bandpass150–3500Hz,10ms onset/offset ramps,global RMS -18dBFS
noise.role: synthetic non-speech burst; not a recorded cough or road noise

fragment.waveform: 180ms exact original PCM from60ms to240ms of initial speech; no gain change
fragment.role: truncated voiced fragment, not non-speech; recognition and any clarification are exploratory, no transcript exactness score

generation: Protocol precedes assets. Freeze every waveform and source hash; all cases remain in live evaluation regardless of offline VAD characterization.
trigger: Publish probe at first conservatively correlated substantive-result PCM using unchanged trigger boundaries; never acknowledgment-only.
observation: Capture a fixed12seconds after the probe input queue drains, even if speech finishes earlier or never resumes. Completion status means observation only; original/current handle states and all PCM determine outcomes. One second of explicitly sent trailing silence is within this12seconds.
expected_effect_check: Exactly one successful start_navigation to P_AIRPORT; no extra or contrary navigation write; preserve every shared tool-log row. Initial effect already completed before probe.
measurement: Record exact input schedule, all raw received frames/events, user-speaking/agent-state events, finalized transcripts, speech handles and actual PCM content. Report VAD activation separately. If no VAD activation occurred, false-interruption recovery was not exercised.
limits: Three dependent repeats percase, fixed declared interleaving, shared warm model/worker andcache confounds; no statistical generalization.
Transport timestamps and concatenated PCM do not establish physical speaker timing or exact RTP/text alignment.
No modelparameter orproduction source tuning based on outcomes during this comparison.
The fragment is speech and cannot be scored as a non-speech ASR hallucination test.
No run is excluded or replaced; failures/noncompletion remain visible.
stack: Same pinnedlocalQwen/Parakeet/Kokoro andloopbackLiveKit asiteration4;MLXprompt-cache-size2. No hostedinference/judging.
